predecessors.note: The Sallarids themselves began in Tarom (919), a Daylami mountain emirate.

capitals.note: Infobox capital Tarom; coordinates approximate. Marzuban's son Ibrahim ruled Azerbaijan from Dvin (page, no years).

rulers.note: ruled Azerbaijan from Dvin; deposed c. 979, died 983 (the page gives no accession year; 957 follows Marzuban's death)

correction.text: Tarom and Shamiran, the Sallarid core

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Sallarid row): the dynasty "ruled in Tarom, Samiran, Daylam, Gilan, then Azerbaijan and Arran"; before 941 the core is Tarom/Shamiran in Zanjan province. The page gives no area.

correction.text: the Sallarid core with Azerbaijan and Dvin

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: 941 "Took Dvin and Azerbaijan"; Marzuban took Azerbaijan from Daysam and ended the Sajid dynasty.

New keyframe, the widest extent: "Early 940s: Took Ardabil and Tabriz; extended rule to Barda, Derbent, and northwestern Azerbaijan. The Shirvanshahs became vassals." Arran and Derbent are drawn from 942 as bridging.

correction.text: Azerbaijan and Arran without the Dvin area and the land northeast of Tabriz

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: 948 Marzuban "defeated and captured. The Rawadids took land northeast of Tabriz, and the Shaddadids took the Dvin area."
New keyframe: "971: The Shaddadids took Ganja."

New keyframe: Ibrahim deposed c. 979, "the end of the Sallarids as a major power in Azerbaijan"; "984: The Rawadids captured Marzuban b. Isma'il, the last Sallarid holding in Azerbaijan" (location not given, not drawn). 989-996: Fakhr al-Dawla holds Shamiran, so no land is known.
New keyframe: 997 Ibrahim "took Shamiran, Zanjan, Abhar, and Suharavard"; "By 1036 the Sallarids were back in Shamiran"; 1062 Toghril received tribute from Musafir at Shamiran.

ledger.note: 919: the Sallarids appear at Tarom. Infobox 'Established 919', capital Tarom, a Shia dynasty of Daylami origin that 'ruled in Tarom, Samiran, Daylam, Gilan'; Muhammad ibn Musafir the first ruler (919-941).

941: Marzuban takes Azerbaijan and Dvin. 'Took Dvin and Azerbaijan'; Marzuban took Azerbaijan from Daysam, ended the Sajid dynasty and 'founded the Sallarid Azerbaijan', repelling the Rus and the Hamdanids of Mosul.
early 940s: Arran and Derbent. 'Took Ardabil and Tabriz; extended rule to Barda, Derbent, and northwestern Azerbaijan.' The page says 'early 940s'; 942 is the rounding.

region.text: Shirvan, the land of the Shirvanshahs

ledger.note: early 940s: the Shirvanshahs become vassals. 'The Shirvanshahs became vassals' (page); 966-968 Ibrahim 'reasserted control over Shirvan and forced tribute from the Shirvanshah'.

948: the Rawadids take land northeast of Tabriz. 'Marzuban was defeated and captured. The Rawadids took land northeast of Tabriz.' (The Buyid Rukn al-Dawla captured Marzuban.) [Reviewer me-08-x, 2026-10-19: confidence 3 to 2: the page puts the Rawadid and Shaddadid gains ('allowed the Rawadids and Shaddadids to take control of the areas to the northeast of Tabriz and Dvin, respectively') in the paragraph after its 948 entry without dating them to that year; the Shaddadid page has Dvin in 951.]

948: the Shaddadids take the Dvin area (the Shaddadid page: Muhammad ibn Shaddad established himself at Dvin in 951). [Reviewer me-08-x, 2026-10-19: confidence 3 to 2: the page puts the Rawadid and Shaddadid gains ('allowed the Rawadids and Shaddadids to take control of the areas to the northeast of Tabriz and Dvin, respectively') in the paragraph after its 948 entry without dating them to that year; the Shaddadid page has Dvin in 951.]
971: the Shaddadids take Ganja. '971: The Shaddadids took Ganja.' (Shaddadid page: Lashkari I took Ganja, 'ending Musafirid influence in Arran'.)

c. 979: the Rawadids overrun Azerbaijan. 'The Rawadids overran much of the province around 979'; Ibrahim was deposed, 'the end of the Sallarids as a major power in Azerbaijan'; in 984 the Rawadids captured Marzuban b. Isma'il, the last Sallarid holding in Azerbaijan.

ledger.counterpart: local rulers of Arran and Derbent
ledger.note: c. 979: Arran and Derbent leave Sallarid hands with Ibrahim's deposition. The page does not say who took them or where Ibrahim ruled after 971; bridging.
c. 979: Sallarid overlordship of the Shirvanshahs ends with Ibrahim's deposition (page silent).
989: 'Buyid Fakhr al-Daula took Shamiran by marrying and divorcing Nuh's widow.'
997: 'Ibrahim b. Marzuban b. Isma'il took Shamiran, Zanjan, Abhar, and Suharavard.' The page does not name the previous holder; the Buyid Fakhr al-Dawla's death is read as the occasion.

region.text: Shamiran, where Toghril received tribute from Musafir in 1062

ledger.note: 1062: the last Sallarid, Musafir, pays tribute to Toghril at Shamiran. Infobox disestablished 1062; 'the dynasty was likely destroyed soon after by the Assassins, who dismantled Shamiran'. About 1043 the Salar of Tarum had already submitted to Toghril Beg.

wars.name: Rus' raid on Barda and the Hamdanid attacks
wars.outcome: Marzuban 'successfully repelled attacks by the Rus and the Hamdanids of Mosul' (941); in 943-944 a Rus' campaign captured Barda, after which Ganja replaced it as the major city of Arran.
wars.note: The Rus' left Barda; no border moved.

wars.name: Buyid and Rawadid-Shaddadid war on Marzuban (948)
wars.outcome: Marzuban won a winter campaign against al-Husain in 945-946 but was defeated and captured by Rukn al-Dawla in 948; the Rawadids took land northeast of Tabriz and the Shaddadids the Dvin area.

wars.name: Shaddadid conquest of Ganja (971)
wars.outcome: Lashkari I took Ganja from the Musafirids, ending their influence in Arran.

wars.name: Rawadid conquest of Azerbaijan
wars.outcome: The Rawadids overran much of the province around 979 when Ibrahim was deposed; in 984 they captured Marzuban b. Isma'il, the last Sallarid holding in Azerbaijan.

certainty.note: Mountain emirate and frontier lordships: the pages name cities and provinces, never lines. Azerbaijan 941-979 is the firmest stretch.

sources.title: Sallarid dynasty

notes: Cliopatria has no Sallarid row (the Sajid Dynasty row ends 935; Azerbaijan 941-979 is otherwise empty). Wikidata id not known; left null. No area on the page. Disagreements: Shaddadids at Dvin 948 (Sallarid page) vs 951 (Shaddadid page); the founder is Muhammad ibn Musafir (919-941), not 'Marzban'. 989-996: no Sallarid land is known (Shamiran in Buyid hands), so there is no keyframe; the 984 'last holding in Azerbaijan' has no location. Not written as events: the Rus' capture of Barda 943-944 (a raid), Ibrahim's 966-968 losses and tribute from Shirvan, 1029 Qazvin (Ibrahim 'took Qazvin and defeated Mas'ud' while Mahmud took Ray; from whom is not given), the c. 1043 submission of the Salar of Tarum to Toghril Beg, Sallarid Tarum after 1062. Counterparts needing dossiers: rawadid-dynasty (Tabriz, 955-c.1116; written here if budget allowed), shaddadids (written here), nizari-ismaili-state (the Assassins, me-09-x), sajid-dynasty (me-08-b). Capital coordinates for Tarom are approximate. Gazetteer names needed: Tarom (Zanjan province), Shamiran, Dvin (drawn as coordinate).
